description.value: The Terry Salman Branch is a neighbourhood branch of the Vancouver Public Library system, located in the Cambie Village area near 31st Avenue. As a public library, it offers a welcoming, free indoor space for visitors. Touring cyclists will find it a useful urban waypoint in an otherwise residential corridor connecting the Cambie Street cycling route.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: safe_loops (16 spaces) at 44m; stands (6 spaces, covered) at 67m; stands at 70m; stands at 72m; safe_loops (16 spaces, covered) at 75m; safe_loops (16 spaces, covered) at 75m; rack (covered) at 76m. Total: 54 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fetch returned only a Cloudflare security challenge page with no usable content, so all amenity fields must rely on OSM tags alone. OSM confirms the branch is a public Vancouver Public Library location with internet_access=wlan and wheelchair=yes tags, but per the evidence rules these OSM amenity tags cannot be treated as authoritative without website corroboration. The looks_closed flag is false and opening_hours are present, supporting confirmed_open=true.
concerns: Website fetch blocked by Cloudflare security challenge; no page content was retrievable. All amenity fields default to null. Contact info could not be cross-checked against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible Vancouver Public Library branch at a confirmed address; useful to touring cyclists as a free indoor rest stop.
